purpose: One digest-bound read model for native panel, Kanban, Markdown, and HTML without a second run-state authority.

domain.responsibility: canonical semantic model and non-authorizing validation

sharedDigest.responsibility: pure canonical JSON and SHA-256 used by inward layers without Node.js imports

sharedSchema.responsibility: single closed-set source for A01-A07 ids, evaluation states, authorization fields, and sensitive-material rejection

data.responsibility: validate and normalize an already trusted point-in-time snapshot

presentation.responsibility: render four configured copies from the canonical model

authoritySnapshot.kernelAttestation: projectRun and resumeRun objects must retain their durable-kernel private identity plus unchanged canonical fingerprint
authoritySnapshot.rule: The stage-runner bridge fresh-reads kernel-attested projectRun and resumeRun objects from the same verified head, then passes A01-A07 envelopes through their canonical result validators. Each canonical result digest is rebound to that settlement. Cloned, modified, raw, or self-signed snapshots are rejected; missing projections remain explicit not_evaluated and make the surface in_doubt.

surfaceCopy.statusColumnMap: configured dense status-to-column mapping; unknown statuses fail closed

statusRule.projected: all seven canonical projections are evaluated
statusRule.in_doubt: one or more canonical projections are not_evaluated or in_doubt
